thesis: Understanding research should investigate which distinctions must be preserved for subsequent reasoning.
role: Defines scope, claim types and limits.

ideas.statement: Execution, discovery and justification are distinct challenges; the working thesis concerns learning relevant distinctions.
SOP Lang is a proposed conceptual research architecture, not a validated general understanding system.
Exact equivalence must be distinguished from sound approximation.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Finite numerical observations do not establish natural-language or general-system performance; AI agreement is not independent validation.

audit.notes: Read every unit; preserve proposed versus demonstrated status.
